triggers.name: new_csv_file
triggers.title: New CSV file
triggers.description: New CSV file in Workato FileStorage
triggers.help: Triggers as soon as a new CSV file with column schema is uploaded to the directory that is being monitored. Returns the rows from the CSV file in batches. To return the whole CSV content as a stream use the "New file" trigger. Use trigger conditions to filter events based on file metadata such as na…

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Trigger will pick all events since the mentioned timestamp. Events older than a week cannot be picked up. If left blank, events since an hour ago will be picked up. Once recipe has been run or tested,…

input.name: dir_path
input.label: Directory path to monitor
input.hint: Choose or enter the directory path to monitor for new CSV files. For example, 'dir1/dir2'.

input.name: include_subdirs
input.label: Include sub-directories?
input.hint: Choose whether to monitor the sub-directories as well within the provided directory or path. By default only the provided directory or path is monitored.

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Enter the batch size, which is the number of records to retrieve per job. Maximum limit is 50000 and default is set to 1000. If the records are bulky, the number of records retrieved will be auto adju…

input.name: schema_type
input.label: CSV column schema
input.hint: Template column schema is required to match and retrieve records from new files in batches. If you have a sample CSV file in a directory, choose the Provide with sample file option.

input.name: schema
input.label: Column schema
input.hint: Describe the schema of the columns in the CSV files that will be processed with this trigger. Only CSV files matching with the provided schema will be processed in the recipe, with permitted relaxatio…

input.name: sample_csv_file
input.label: Sample CSV file
input.hint: Select a sample CSV file to understand the column schema of the CSV files that will be processed with this trigger. Only CSV files matching with the provided schema will be processed in the recipe, wi…

input.name: selected_fields
input.label: Columns to retrieve
input.hint: Select the subset of CSV columns to retrieve that you will be using in your recipe. If left blank all columns will be retrieved.

input.name: ignore_schema_mismatch
input.label: Skip files with schema mismatches
input.hint: Choose the behavior when the trigger encounters CSV files with mismatched schema. Choose "Yes" to skip such files and only process files with matching schema. Choose "No" to explicitly throw error whe…

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the requested file

triggers.name: new_file
triggers.title: New File
triggers.help: Used to trigger real-time when a new file is created/uploaded to a chosen directory in Workato FileStorage. This trigger is streaming compatible and can be paired up with both streaming and non-streaming actions (for small volume data).

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Leave empty to get new rows since one hour ago. Events older than a week are not picked up . Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

input.name: dir_path
input.label: Directory path to monitor
input.hint: Choose or enter the directory path to monitor. For example, “directory1/directory2/”.

input.name: include_subdirs
input.label: Include sub-directories?
input.hint: Choose whether to monitor sub-directories as well within the chosen directory path. By default only the given directory will be monitored

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the requested file

triggers.name: new_lines_in_csv_file
triggers.title: New lines in CSV file
triggers.description: New CSV lines in file in Workato FileStorage
triggers.help: Monitors an existing CSV file and fetches new lines added to the file in batches as soon as they are appended. Existing lines in the recipe will be fetched at the recipe start.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File to monitor
input.hint: Choose or enter the complete path of the CSV file to monitor for new lines. Only files stored with CSV column schema can be monitored.

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Enter the batch size, which is the number of records to retrieve per job. Maximum limit is 50000 and default is set to 1000. If the records are bulky, the number of records retrieved will be auto adju…

input.name: selected_fields
input.label: Columns to retrieve
input.hint: Select the subset of CSV columns to retrieve that you will be using in your recipe. If left blank all columns will be retrieved

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the requested file

actions.name: append_to_file
actions.title: Append to file
actions.description: Append to file in Workato FileStorage
actions.help: Appends content to an existing file in the Workato FileStorage. If the file does not exist in the provided path, a new file is created and the content will be added to the new file.

input.name: is_csv_file
input.label: Append CSV content
input.hint: Choose Yes to create/append CSV content to new/existing CSV file with column schema in FileStorage. Defaults to No .

input.name: file_path
input.label: Select file
input.hint: Choose the file to append content to it. If the file does not exist, new file will be created. Only existing CSV files stored with column schema are shown in the dropdown if 'Append CSV content' is se…

input.name: content
input.label: Content to append
input.hint: The content to be appended to the file.

input.name: schema_type
input.label: CSV column schema setup
input.hint: Choose whether to automatically infer data types for CSV columns from the append data or to set it manually. FileStorage can automatically set the best possible data type matches for the columns in th…

input.name: schema
input.label: Column schema
input.hint: Describe the schema of the columns in your CSV data. If the provided column data types do not match with the existing file, error is returned.

input.name: csv_has_header
input.label: Contains header row
input.hint: Select Yes if the CSV content to be appended has header row. Defaults to No . On appends, header row will always be trimmed.

input.name: csv_preserve_header
input.label: Add header at file creation
input.hint: Choose Yes to add header to the CSV file only when the first append is creating the file. Defaults to No, which trims header always, both at file creation and at subsequent appends.

input.name: csv_delimiter
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: Choose the character that separates column values in the CSV content. Defaults is set to 'comma'.

input.name: csv_quote
input.label: Quote character
input.hint: Choose the quotation marks used as escape characters in the CSV content. Defaults is set to 'Double'.

input.name: encoding
input.label: File encoding
input.hint: Set the encoding of the source file contents. Default is set to 'UTF-8'

actions.name: create_shareable_link
actions.title: Generate shareable file link
actions.description: Generate shareable file link in Workato FileStorage
actions.help: Allows users to create a temporary authenticated URL for a file in Workato FileStorage that can be shared externally. With this URL, a third party can download, upload or append contents to this file for the specified duration.

input.name: scope
input.label: Scope
input.hint: Choose the scope possible in the file. For example, “Upload” allows users to create new file and upload contents to it. “Upload” does not work on an existing file.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Choose or enter the complete path of the file. For example, “directory1/directory2/filename”.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: The name of the file to be created.

input.name: file_dir
input.label: File path
input.hint: Select or enter a path where file needs to be created. If the path does not exist then error is returned. For example, “samplepath/path1/”.

input.name: expires_in
input.label: Expires in
input.hint: Denote duration for expiration of this shareable link in seconds. Defaults to 900 seconds, maximum is 604800 (7 days).

actions.name: delete_directory
actions.title: Delete directory
actions.help: Use this action to delete a directory in Workato FileStorage.

input.name: directory_path
input.label: Directory path
input.hint: Enter the full path of the directory to be deleted. For example, "samplepath/dirname." You can use the select toggle to choose the file instead.

output.name: path
output.label: Directory path
output.hint: Full path of the deleted directory

actions.name: delete_file
actions.title: Delete file
actions.help: Deletes the selected file in Workato FileStorage.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Enter the full path of the file to be deleted. For example, “samplepath/filename.csv.” You can use the select toggle toc choose the file instead.

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the deleted file

actions.name: ensure_dir_exists
actions.title: Create directory
actions.help: Create a directory in Workato FileStorage system by specifying the name and the path.

input.name: directory_name
input.label: Directory name
input.hint: The name of the directory to be created.

input.name: directory_path
input.label: Directory path
input.hint: Choose or enter the complete path of the directory to be created. Creates the complete path if not present already. For example, “samplepath/path1”

actions.name: get_csv_file_contents
actions.title: Get lines from CSV file
actions.description: Get lines from CSV file in Workato FileStorage
actions.help: Returns a batch of lines from CSV file. The number of returned csv lines defaults to 1000 and can be increased to maximum of 50000 records. Only files stored as CSV files with schema can be fetched.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Specify the path of the csv file to fetch lines from. For example, “samplepath/path1/file1”. The file needs to exist before fetching the contents. Only files stored with CSV column schema can be fetch…

input.name: schema_type
input.label: CSV column schema
input.hint: Select the schema template of the file that is to be retrieved in batches. If you have a sample CSV file in the directory, choose “Provide with sample file” option. If not, select “Provide manually” t…

input.name: schema
input.label: Column schema
input.hint: Describe the schema of the columns in the CSV files that needs to be fetched. Only records from the CSV files matching with the provided schema can be fetched, with permitted relaxations. To learn mor…

input.name: sample_csv_file
input.label: Sample CSV file
input.hint: Choose a sample CSV file that has the same column schema as the incoming file. Only records from CSV files matching the provided schema can be fetched, with permitted relaxations. To learn more, click…

input.name: selected_fields
input.label: Columns to retrieve
input.hint: Select the columns to be returned in the output datatree. If left blank, all columns will be retrieved.

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Enter the batch size, which is the number of records to retrieve in a single fetch. Maximum is 50000 and default is set to 1000. If the records are bulky, the number of records retrieved will be auto …

input.name: batch_offset
input.label: Batch offset
input.hint: Skip and fetch records from the defined offset. By default offset is set to 0. By looping through offsets iteratively, all records can be fetched easily.

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the requested file

actions.name: get_file_contents
actions.title: Get file contents
actions.description: Get file contents in Workato FileStorage
actions.help: Returns the contents of a file stored in Workato FileStorage. This action is streaming compatible and can be paired up with both streaming and non-streaming actions.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Enter the file path to get the file contents. The action will throw an error if the file or the path does not exist. For example, “samplepath/filename.csv”. You can use the select toggle to choose the…

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the requested file

output.name: modified_at
output.label: Last modified time
output.hint: The last time the file was modified

actions.name: move_file
actions.title: Rename/move file
actions.help: Use this action to rename a file or move a file to a new destination in Workato FileStorage.

input.name: source_file_path
input.label: Source file path
input.hint: Choose or enter the path of the source file that needs to be moved or renamed. For example, “directory1/directory2/filename”. Note - the file must exist in the path or the action returns error.

input.name: destination_dir_path
input.label: Destination directory path
input.hint: Choose or enter the directory path where the file needs to be moved to. For renaming, provide the same directory path as source. For example, “directory1/directory2”.

input.name: destination_file_name
input.label: Destination file name
input.hint: Enter the destination file name. For file moving, you can provide either the same name or a different name for the destination file.

actions.name: search_files
actions.title: Search files
actions.help: Searches and returns the files that match the file name and condition provided in Workato FileStorage. Files under sub-directories are also included in the search. Make use of pagination to fetch larger lists of files. Not providing any input values will return all files available under a directory …

input.name: file_path
input.label: Directory path
input.hint: Choose the directory path under which to search for matching files.

input.name: file_name_filter
input.label: File name
input.hint: Fetches files that match the given value of file name and according to the condition specified

input.name: page_size
input.label: Page size
input.hint: Page size defines the number of file records to be fetched in a single set. Default is 50. A maximum of 100 records can be returned.

input.name: page
input.label: Page offset
input.hint: Page offset denotes the specific page number to fetch the associated file records of that page. Default offset is 0, denoting the first page.

properties.name: modified_at
properties.label: Last modified time
properties.hint: The last time the file was modified

actions.name: store_file
actions.title: Create file
actions.help: Create a new file in Workato FileStorage by uploading the file contents provided. This action is streaming compatible and can be paired up with both streaming and non-streaming actions.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: The name of the file to be created.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Select or enter a path where file needs to be created. If the path does not exist then error is returned. For example, “samplepath/path1/”.

input.name: content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: The file contents to be uploaded.

input.name: is_csv_file
input.label: Create CSV file
input.hint: Choose “Yes” to store content as a CSV file with column schema. CSV column schema setup is required for fetching CSV file data in batches via FileStorage triggers.

input.name: schema_type
input.label: CSV column schema setup
input.hint: Choose whether to automatically infer names and data types of the CSV columns or to set it manually. FileStorage can automatically fetch column names from the header row and set the best possible data…

input.name: schema
input.label: Column schema
input.hint: Describe the names and the data types of the columns in your CSV data. The columns added top to bottom here will be matched to the CSV contents from left to right.

input.name: csv_has_header
input.label: Contains header row
input.hint: Select Yes if the CSV data has header row. Defaults to Yes .

input.name: csv_delimiter
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: Choose the character that separates column values in the CSV content. Defaults is set to 'comma'.

input.name: csv_quote
input.label: Quote character
input.hint: Choose the quotation marks used as escape characters in the CSV content. Defaults is set to 'Double'.

input.name: encoding
input.label: File encoding
input.hint: Set the encoding of the source file contents. Default is set to 'UTF-8'.

input.name: overwrite
input.label: Overwrite existing file
input.hint: Choose 'Yes' to overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to 'No'.

output.name: path
output.label: File path
output.hint: Full path of the uploaded file
